title: Three Children Playing with Toys on Floor, 1950s Snapshot Photo
description: Three young children, two girls and a boy, sit together on a patterned living room carpet surrounded by a boxed playset, toy structures, and miniature figures, likely after Christmas or a birthday in the late 1950s. The girls wear matching dark tops and skirts detailed with decorative white rickrack trim, sporting 1950s style bangs. Mid-century furniture legs and an armchair complete the cozy domestic setting.
